raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner adopted an incorrect “standardization” to use the first listed date on IMDb’s Release Dates page (which can be later home-media entries) instead of the earliest public release. This led them to treat Week-End with Father as 2011 rather than its well-sourced 1951 release and to claim Premium (2007/2006) was earlier, contradicting credible sources (Wikipedia, IMDb, TCM) and the task requirement to find the earliest release dates.
